verdict.rationale: First-party docs and the GitHub README state that for every secret TruffleHog can classify, it can log in to the issuing service to confirm whether the secret is live. Filtering and control are documented through `--only-verified`, `--results=verified,unknown`, and per-detector `--verify-detectors`/`--no-verify-detectors` flags. Custom detectors can be verified via a webhook, and `trufflehog analyze` goes further to map a key's permissions and resources. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of verification accuracy, since the community items do not address this capability.
